en.headline: Police arrest 22 in Sham Shui Po crackdown on high-interest loan syndicate
en.dek: Sham Shui Po crime officers dismantled a group operating two licensed finance companies in Yau Ma Tei that charged effective annual rates above 300 per cent and used intimidation to collect debts.
body: Police said they arrested 22 people, including a ringleader and core members, in an operation against a high-interest lending and illegal debt-collection syndicate active in West Kowloon.

Sham Shui Po District Crime Squad officers acted between 9 and 15 October after analysing related cases. They raided two licensed finance companies in the same Yau Ma Tei commercial building controlled by the same group. The companies advertised fast approval without credit checks but deducted fees that pushed effective annual interest rates above 300 per cent, well above the statutory 48 per cent ceiling, police said. Some collectors used criminal intimidation and poured oil as a threat; some had triad backgrounds.

Officers seized more than 1,000 loan documents, computers, phones, about HK$2 million in cash, watches and gold, and froze about HK$1 million in a company account. They also recovered two luxury cars worth about HK$1.2 million from the residences of those in charge. Company bank accounts recorded over HK$90 million in transactions in the past year. The operation continues and further arrests are not ruled out.

zh.headline: 警搭高利貸集團拘捕22人 包括主腦及骨幹成員
zh.dek: 深水埗警區刑事部行動中拘捕22人，揭發兩間油麻地持牌財務公司實際年利率逾300%，並以恐嚇及淋油等手段收數。
body: 警方表示，深水埗警區刑事部於10月9日至15日採取行動，針對西九龍區高利貸及非法收數活動，拘捕22人，包括集團主腦及骨幹成員。
調查發現集團操控油麻地同一幢商業大廈內兩間持放債人牌照的財務公司，以快速批核、免信貸審查作招俣，但巧立名目扣除手續費，實際年利率遠超法定上限48%，甚至逾300%。部分收數人有黑社會背景，曾以刑事恐嚇及淋紅油等手段追債。
行動檢獲逾千份借貸文件、電腦、電話、約200萬元現金、名錶及金飾，並凍結公司戶口約100萬元資產；另在負責人住所檢獲兩部價值約120萬元的名車。相關公司戶口過去一年交易紀錄逾9000萬元。警方指行動仍在繼續，不排除進一步拘捕。
